tools.name: scan_repository
tools.description: Clone a public git repository and run feldspar-scan: OSV.dev advisories for pinned dependencies in lockfiles (npm, pnpm, yarn, pip/uv/poetry, Cargo, Go, Gemfile.lock), secret patterns with redacted evidence, and configuration lint. Returns a JSON report with summary counts and per-finding severity,

tools.name: audit_pricing
tools.description: Returns the scope, prices, delivery times, terms and order links of Project Feldspar's paid code audits, which an AI agent performs. Use it when the user asks about a paid code audit. No arguments.
